The Synology RKS-02 Sliding Rail Kit is designed specifically for Synology rackmount servers, providing a convenient solution for mounting and accessing your server equipment. With the sliding rails, you can easily pull out the server from the rack for maintenance or installation tasks without the need for heavy lifting or disassembling the entire rack. The mount post width of your rack must be equal to or greater than 450 mm, while the panel width should be equal to or greater than 480 mm. Synology DiskStation DS223j 2-Bays NAS Enclosure

The Synology DiskStation DS223j 2-Bays NAS Enclosure is designed as an efficient one-stop solution for all your data storage needs, allowing you to create a private cloud to protect your files, share your data across multiple devices, store security footage with intelligent video surveillance tools, and more. It has two drive bays that can natively accept 3.5" SATA hard drives, as well as 2.5" SATA hard drives and SSDs. The DiskStation DS223j NAS Storage is powered by Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) OS, a browser-based operating system that aids in the management of your Synology NAS. Its CPU is a 1.7 GHz Realtek RTD1619B Quad-Core, and its 1GB of DDR4 RAM enables for speedy access to commonly used files and apps. It also has two USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 ports for connecting external drives or other devices, and network communication is provided by the inbuilt Gigabit Ethernet connector, which allows your saved data to be shared with users across the network. The DS223j may also serve as a multimedia management, streaming, and playback solution. The DS223j supports RAID 0 and 1, as well as Synology Hybrid RAID and Basic RAID, all of which provide performance, data redundancy, or a mix of the two. JBOD, which allows each drive bay to be used independently, is also available for individuals who do not require a RAID. A 92 x 92mm fan keeps the system cool at all times, and the server supports multiple programmed power on / off cycles as well as hard disk hibernation to further reduce power consumption and operating costs.

Synology DiskStation DS225+ 2-Bays NAS Enclosure

The Synology DiskStation DS225+ 2-Bays NAS Enclosure, equipped with a quad-core CPU, an AES-NI hardware encryption engine, and Btrfs file system compatibility, is a tiny NAS designed to offer centralized data management to small enterprises and teams. The DS225+ has two drive bays that can natively accept 3.5" SATA hard drives as well as 2.5" SATA hard drives and SSDs. With up to 2048 user accounts and 1500 maximum concurrent connections, this NAS can store and distribute a vast amount of data using its two storage bays. Remote data access is also possible via the free iOS and Android applications. RAID 0 and 1, as well as Synology Hybrid RAID and Basic RAID, are all supported by the Synology DS225+ NAS Storage and provide performance, data redundancy, or a combination of the two. Individuals who do not require a RAID can alternatively utilize JBOD, which allows each disk bay to be used individually. The DS225+ has been intended to be energy efficient. It not only features a 92 x 92mm fan to keep the system cool at all times, but it also has a noise dampening design with a rating of 22 dBA for silent operation. The server also supports multiple planned power on/off cycles and hard disk hibernation to further cut power consumption and running expenses.

Combine the Ethernet ports and connect to a 2.5-Gigabit Ethernet switch to take advantage of extreme speeds. Break free from restrictions with the Lockerstor 12RD. Wide compatibility in various Platforms

ASUSTOR NAS users can now run the native Linux system on their NAS, enjoying the rich variety of Linux apps. Linux Center features easy installation without extra configurations. It effectively turns the NAS into a computer with unlimited possibilities. The ASUSTOR NAS provides seamless cross-platform and multi-user access, allowing you to easily connect to your NAS from Windows, macOS, or Unix-like operating systems no matter if you are using a PC, notebook, or tablet, or smartphone. It also supports ASUSTOR EZ Sync, Snapshot Center, Cloud Backup Center, DataSync Center, Mobile Apps, Portainer Easy Docker Deployment, App Central, RAID storage technology, Strengthens ADM Account Security, and Seamless integration with Easy management. The HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen 11 Server is a 2U rack-mountable enterprise server. This Server runs dual Intel Xeon Silver 4516Y+ processors, each delivering 2.2GHz base speed across 24 cores at 185W TDP for capable, energy-efficient parallel processing performance. The Intel C741 chipset provides a reliable, high-performance platform supporting the server's advanced memory, storage, and I/O subsystems across continuous mission-critical operations.

This HPE Rack Server includes 256GB of DDR5-5600 MT/s registered memory across four 64GB dual-rank RDIMM modules. The HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen 11 Intel Xeon Silver Rack Server has an HPE MR408i-o Gen11 RAID controller with 4GB cache and x8 PCIe lanes supports RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, and 10 configurations for comprehensive, flexible storage protection across diverse deployment scenarios.

Eight HPE 2.4TB SAS 12G 10K SFF hot-plug hard drives provide 19.2TB of raw mission-critical storage capacity with hot-plug capability for zero-downtime drive replacement during live operation. An HPE NS204i-u v2 NVMe boot device houses two 480GB NVMe M.2 SSDs in hardware RAID 1 for fast, redundant operating system boot performance. A Broadcom BCM57416 dual-port 10GbE BASE-T network adapter delivers fast, reliable data center network connectivity for high-throughput enterprise traffic management. The HPE Rack Mount Server includes a dedicated iLO Advanced license management port for comprehensive remote server monitoring, administration, and troubleshooting capabilities from any location. Two hot-pluggable 800W redundant power supplies with six cooling fans ensure continuous, reliable power and thermal management during sustained maximum performance operation.

This HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen 11 Intel Xeon Silver Rack Server USB connectivity includes one front USB 3.2 Gen1, two rear USB 3.0, and two internal secure USB ports for versatile peripheral connectivity. A rear VGA port supports direct local console display connection for initial configuration and on-site server administration tasks. The complete 2U package includes a rail kit, cable management arm, and bezel kit for professional enterprise rack installation.

Asus ESC8000-E11 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable GPU Server and ASUS ASMB11-iKVM

The ASUS ESC8000-E11 is a powerful GPU server built for demanding AI and High-Performance Computing (HPC) tasks. It features 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors that provide up to 21% more general-purpose performance per watt. It supports up to eight dual-slot GPUs and contains the NVIDIA NVLink bridge for performance scalability, as well as up to 32 DIMM slots that support DDR5 memory for faster data processing. When used with the ASUS ASMB11-iKVM, a baseboard management console module, the server enables administrators to remotely monitor, run, and automate provisioning, configuration, and monitoring. The ASMB11-iKVM minimizes downtime through remote troubleshooting and repairs, provides security and compliance, and enables out-of-band management even when the server is turned off or unresponsive. Together, these components offer a robust, dependable, and secure framework for managing high-performance computing environments.

Synology DiskStation DS3622xs+ 12 Bays Desktop NAS Storage

The Synology DiskStation DS3622xs+ is a high-performance 12-bay desktop NAS storage solution aimed for companies and demanding consumers. This NAS is equipped with an Intel Xeon D-1531 CPU, which has a base frequency of 2.2 GHz and a turbo boost capacity of up to 2.7 GHz. Its 6 CPU cores guarantee effective processing power for applications that require a lot of resources and multitasking. With four memory ports that allow for expansion up to 48 GB, the system's 16 GB DDR4 ECC SODIMM memory allows for seamless operation even under demanding workloads. It also has a PCIe expansion slot and two USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, which enable more customization. AES-NI encryption and 256-bit AES encryption ensure data safety, while a lockable bay door provides physical security. Security is of the utmost importance. Multiple RAID configurations, such as RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, 10, Basic, F1, and JBOD, are supported by the Synology DiskStation DS3622xs+ 12 Bays NAS Storage, allowing for customized data management and redundancy. With remarkable read and write speeds of up to 4719 MB/s and 2400 MB/s, the DS3622xs Plus is ideal for workloads involving a lot of data. Utilizing the intuitive Synology DiskStation Manager operating system, it provides a smooth and effortless file, application, and backup management experience. With its unmatched storage capacity and performance, the Synology DiskStation DS3622xs+ is ideal for both home offices and expanding businesses.

Description

Asustor LOCKERSTOR 12R Pro AS7112RDX 12-Bays NAS Storage

The Lockerstor 12R/16R Pro features a powerful Intel 9th generation Xeon with four cores. Not only is the Xeon extremely fast in both read and write speeds, but also lends incredible performance to virtual machines and Docker apps. ECC memory is memory usually used in servers for detection and correction of the most common kinds of data corruption. This can help prevent data loss due to electromagnetic interference or crashes, making the NAS the Lockerstor 12R pro our most stable NAS ever. The Lockerstor 12R Pro and 16R Pro are equipped with serverâ€“grade redundant 80 PLUS Platinum PSUs. The efficient power supplies installed ensure stability when running your NAS for various apps like virtualization. The included power supplies also increase energy efficiency as they are up to 94% efficient in 50% load and remain efficient at almost any load. This enables enterprise customers to save power and money while also being green. With internal hard drive hibernation, the Lockerstor 12R Pro and 16R Pro consume only 45.5 W of power while normal operation only consumes 92.4 W of power. The Lockerstor 12R Pro(2U) features comprehensive backup solutions. The built-in redundant power supply and 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports effectively increase reliability, data integrity and execution speeds. The Ethernet ports and power supply all feature failover capabilities (when one fails, the other can continue to operate) in order to ensure for continuous data availability. In enterprise environments, storage devices are commonly placed together in a server room. In order to allow administrators to quickly find the NAS from among many servers the Lockerstor 12R Pro(2U) / Lockerstor 16R Pro(3U) provides a dedicated button on front panel. When this button is pressed, the LED service light on the rear panel of the NAS will light up. ASUSTOR also offers the mobile NAS management app, AiMaster which provides the exclusive Find Me function. When Find Me is activated, the system status light on the front of the NAS will flash and the system buzzer will sound, helping users to quickly find the NAS. The Lockerstor 12R Pro and 16R Pro help businesses meet the expansion needs of tomorrow, today. The Lockerstor 12R Pro and 16R Pro come equipped with two x4 PCIe slots and one x8 slot for SAS cards to use SAS drives and SAS expansion boxes, allowing easier capacity expansion and seamless integration with existing server drives. Moreover, the PCI Express slots also enable seamless expansion of 10GbE /25GbE / 40GbE / 50GbE network card, enabling greater speeds than ever before. All ASUSTOR NAS are designed for and are suitable for 24/7 use. ASUSTOR NAS devices have also undergone rigorous tests, such as drop tests and burn tests to test durability in extreme conditions. Heatsinks were added to sensitive components to dissipate heat, helping to maintain the longevity of the device. Protect your data from loss, damage and attacks with the Lockerstor Pro. A Lockerstor Pro is better protected by running the Linux-based ADM, employing a built-in firewall, ClamAV Antivirus, MyArchive and ADMâ€™s various backup tools help protect ransomware even better. The Lockerstor Pro comes with the most up-to-date version of ADM to help protect against ransomware attacks. Snapshot Center and Btrfs provide the ability to efficiently create snapshots to protect and easily restore lost data. Other security features found on the Lockerstor Pro are the ability to create one or more replacement administrator accounts, a firewall by ADM Defender that features blacklists and whitelists, the ability to change default ports, disable SSH and Terminal to prevent remote attacks. MyArchive cold storage hard drive security can also be increased by implementing AES 256bit encryption. ASUSTORâ€™s comprehensive backup solution provides more than twelve backup options, including, but not limited to Amazon S3, Dropbox, Google Drive, and Onedrive. ASUSTOR Backup Plan for Windows as well as Time Machine for macOS provide easy backups for desktop and laptops while MyArchive removable hard drives provide long term storage. Btrfs is now supported and with Snapshot Center, can take snapshots of your information in the event of unintentional modification. Restore previous versions easily with Snapshot Center. The Lockerstor 12R Pro provides enterprise-class hardware and software and is compatible with VMware, Citrix, Hyper-V virtual storage environments. iSCSI/IP-SAN and NFS support allow it to seamless integrate with existing IT environments, providing an optimal and cost-effective storage solution.

Cisco UCS C240 M6 2U SFF 12 Core Rack Server

The Cisco UCS C240 M6 2U SFF 12-Core Rack Server is a server intended to deliver great performance and scalability in enterprise-level applications and data center environments. This adaptable rack server is designed to handle a variety of workloads, including intense virtualized environments, mission-critical databases, and commercial applications. The Cisco UCS C240 M6 is powered by two Intel Xeon Scalable 4310 processors, each having a 2.1GHz base clock speed that can be increased to 3.6GHz, giving it a total of 24 cores and 36 threads for effective parallel processing. These processors include an 18MB L3 cache per processor and a thermal design power (TDP) of 120W, guaranteeing high performance for demanding computing activities and applications. The UCS C240 M6 server has 64GB of DDR4 RAM, which is made up of two 32GB RDIMM DRx4 3200 MHz memory modules. This high-capacity memory configuration enables rapid and efficient data access, making it excellent for operating complicated virtual machines, maintaining huge databases, and supporting high-traffic web applications. DDR4 3200 MHz memory provides high bandwidth and low latency, resulting in excellent server performance. The Cisco UCS C240 M6 comes equipped with three 2.4TB 12G SAS 10K RPM SFF HDDs, totaling 7.2TB of raw storage capacity. These HDDs run at 10,000 RPM, providing rapid read and write rates for high-performance data processing. The 12G SAS interface provides high-speed data transfer rates and durability, and the 4K sector size improves storage economy and performance for enterprise applications. The server has a Cisco 12G SAS RAID Controller with 4GB of Flash-backed Write Cache (FBWC), which can support up to 16 disks for a variety of RAID configurations, including RAID 0, 1, 5, 6, 10, and 50. The RAID controller has extensive capabilities for data redundancy, fault tolerance, and performance optimization, assuring vital data protection and server uptime. The Cisco UCS C240 M6 is designed for flexible deployment and is available in a 2U rack-mountable form factor, making it perfect for data centers and IT environments with limited space but high performance requirements. The 2U chassis enables a wide range of configurations and choices for growing storage, memory, and connection to meet changing business demands. The server's backplane supports hot-swappable drives, allowing for quick replacement of storage components with no downtime. The server's architecture also incorporates integrated management tools including Cisco Intersight for cloud-based monitoring and management, and Cisco UCS Manager for centralized server administration and automation.

The Dell PowerEdge R750xs Intel Xeon Silver 4310 Rack Server is a heavy powerful 2U rackmount solution designed for demanding enterprise workloads, combining exceptional processing power, scalability, and advanced system management. The chassis supports up to 8×2.5" SAS/SATA drives in a dual-CPU configuration and offers flexible expansion with riser options supporting up to 6 PCIe Gen 3 slots. I/O connectivity includes front ports (1×iDRAC Direct Micro-AB USB, 1×USB 2.0, 1×VGA) and rear ports (1×USB 2.0, 1×USB 3.0, 2×Ethernet, 1×VGA). Additional features include TPM 2.0 V3 for enhanced security, a Ready Rails sliding rail kit without cable management arm, and two C13/C14 4M jumper cords. With no pre-installed operating system, the Dell PowerEdge R750xs Intel Xeon Silver 4310 Rack Server offers full flexibility for deployment, making it an ideal choice for virtualization, database hosting, and large-scale application workloads.

Synology RackStation RS1619xs+ 4-Bays NAS Enclosure

RS1619xs+ is a high-performance and scalable 1U rackmount NAS designed with upgradable memory and M.2 SSD cache configuration to meet the needs of modern businesses that require a flexible, reliable, and efficient storage solution. Equipped with a PCIe 3.0 slot, RS1619xs+ supports installing a 10GbE/25GbE NIC for fast data transmission. Built-in M.2 2280 SSD cache slots further benefit IO-intensive tasks, such as virtualization or mail server deployment.

Public Cloud Integration

Back up and synchronize data easily between public cloud accounts and your NAS. It offers an award-winning operating system with an intuitive user interface and powerful capabilities.

Hyper Backup

A comprehensive backup and recovery solution for added data protection. Create backup destinations locally, on another Synology device, rsync servers, or cloud-based destinations, such as Google Drive, Dropbox, S3-compatible destinations, and Synology C2 Storage, a dedicated backup destination for Synology devices. Deduplication, integrity checks and incremental transfer technology reduce bandwidth and storage use. Engineered to handle 24/7 workloads, Synology drives are designed to provide high performance. This NAS works well with Synology's SAT5200 2.5" SSD and SNV3400 M.2 SSD.

Snapshot Replication

Easily schedule flexible point-in-time backups of shared folders and LUNs with an RPO as low as 5 minutes and recovery in seconds. Set up replication and failover to other Synology storage systems for fast RTOs and minimal service disruption.

Security

Powered by Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM), Synology NAS offers advanced security measures to protect against sudden data loss and potential security holes. Schedulable and instantaneous data protection of shared folders and iSCSI LUNs for quick disaster recovery. Shield your Synology NAS from the most sophisticated threats with industry-leading security solutions. And analyze system settings, password strength and network preferences, and remove any possible malware.

products.description:
Description

Synology RackStation RS1221RP+ 8-Bays NAS Enclosure

The RackStation RS1221RP+ is powered by a 2.2 GHz AMD Ryzen V1500B Quad-Core processor, which will allow you to run multiple functions simultaneously. The 4GB of DDR4 ECC RAM will allow quick access to frequently used files and programs and may also be upgraded to a total of 32GB by installing a 16GB module into each of the SO-DIMM slots. Also featured are two USB 3.0 Type-A ports and one eSATA port. Network connectivity is achieved via the four Gigabit Ethernet ports with failover support, which help to provide redundancy in the case that a LAN connection malfunction occurs on one port. In addition, link aggregation, powered by four LAN ports, helps to increase connection speeds beyond the limits of a single network port or cable. If you're looking to expand this NAS, there is one PCIe 3.0 x8/x4 slot that can be used to create an NVMe M.2 SSD cache, add a 10GbE network card, and more.

Rebundant Power

Synology has engineered the RackStation RS1221RP+ to be energy efficient. Not only does it offer two 80 x 80mm fans to help keep the system running cool, the server supports numerous scheduled power on / off cycles and hard-drive hibernation to further minimize power consumption and operational expenses. The RackStation RS1221RP+ operates on 100-240 VAC at 50/60 Hz and includes an accessory pack and two AC power cords. Sequential reads of up to 2315 MB/s and sequential writes of up to 1147 MB/s, with random reads over 100,000 IOPS and random writes over 54,000 IOPS all help to ensure ample performance for demanding workloads.

Hyper Backup

A comprehensive backup and recovery solution for added data protection. Create backup destinations locally, on another Synology device, rsync servers, or cloud-based destinations, such as Google Drive, Dropbox, S3-compatible destinations, and Synology C2 Storage, a dedicated backup destination for Synology devices. Deduplication, integrity checks and incremental transfer technology reduce bandwidth and storage use. Engineered to handle 24/7 workloads, Synology drives are designed to provide high performance. This NAS works well with Synology's SAT5200 2.5" SSD and SNV3400 M.2 SSD.

Snapshot Replication

Easily schedule flexible point-in-time backups of shared folders and LUNs with an RPO as low as 5 minutes and recovery in seconds. Set up replication and failover to other Synology storage systems for fast RTOs and minimal service disruption.

Storage Virtualization Solutions

Synology iSCSI storage fully supports mainstream virtualization solutions to enhance work efficiency with an easy management interface. VMware vSphere 6 and VAAI integration helps offload storage operations. Windows Offloaded Data Transfer (ODX) speeds up data transfers. OpenStack Cinder support turns your Synology NAS into a block-based storage component. Additionally, Synology Storage Console enables even more simplified storage provisioning and management options in VMware and Windows environments.

ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Intel Xeon E-2336 Tower Server

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Tower Server is powered by an Intel Xeon E-2336 Processor (2.90GHz up to 4.80GHz), with 6 cores and 12 threads. This server ensures seamless multitasking and fast processing. It comes with 16GB of RAM and supports up to 128GB, making it capable of handling demanding workloads and data-intensive applications. The server offers excellent storage options with 2 x 1TB SATA3 ENTERPRISE 6Gbps hard drives and supports software RAID 0, 1, 10 & 5 using Intel Rapid Storage Technology Enterprise (RSTe). Two Intel I210-AT LAN ports as well as a management port provide strong connectivity. Along with numerous USB ports, the server has VGA, HDMI (which can only be used with an iGPU), and audio jacks. Server management is made simple and effective with the ASUS Control Center Enterprise and ASMB10-iKVM card. The Aspeed AST2510 graphics card has 64MB VRAM and an 80PLUS Single Power Supply with a 300W rating, which further improves both performance and reliability. The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 is a versatile and dependable server solution for businesses that is compatible with a number of operating systems, including Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, RedHat Enterprise Linux, SuSE Linux Enterprise Server, CentOS, and VMware.

PCIe 4.0 Ready for Enhanced Performance

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 embraces the cutting-edge PCIe 4.0 technology, delivering 16 GT/s bandwidth, double the speed of PCIe 3.0. This enables lower power consumption, better lane scalability, and backwards compatibility, ensuring flexible scalability for demanding workloads.

Robust Server-Management Solution

ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 incorporates the ASUS ASMB10-iKVM, a powerful server-management solution based on the ASPEED 2600 chipset and AMI MegaRAC SP-X. It enables out-of-band server management through WebGUI, IPMI, and Redfish API, streamlining server administration and ensuring seamless control.

Enhanced Security

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 integrates PFR FPGA as the platform Root-of-Trust solution, it ensures firmware resiliency, safeguarding your infrastructure from potential hackers. ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Intel Xeon E-2378 Tower Server

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Tower Server is powered by an Intel Xeon E-2378 Processor (2.60GHz up to 4.80GHz), with 8 cores and 16 threads. This server ensures seamless multitasking and fast processing. It comes with 16GB of RAM and supports up to 128GB, making it capable of handling demanding workloads and data-intensive applications. The server offers excellent storage options with 2 x 1TB SATA3 ENTERPRISE 6Gbps hard drives and supports software RAID 0, 1, 10 & 5 using Intel Rapid Storage Technology Enterprise (RSTe). Two Intel I210-AT LAN ports as well as a management port provide strong connectivity. Along with numerous USB ports, the server has VGA, HDMI (which can only be used with an iGPU), and audio jacks. Server management is made simple and effective with the ASUS Control Center Enterprise and ASMB10-iKVM card. The Aspeed AST2510 graphics card has 64MB VRAM and an 80PLUS Single Power Supply with a 300W rating, which further improves both performance and reliability. The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 is a versatile and dependable server solution for businesses that is compatible with a number of operating systems, including Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, RedHat Enterprise Linux, SuSE Linux Enterprise Server, CentOS, and VMware.

PCIe 4.0 Ready for Enhanced Performance

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 embraces the cutting-edge PCIe 4.0 technology, delivering 16 GT/s bandwidth, double the speed of PCIe 3.0. This enables lower power consumption, better lane scalability, and backwards compatibility, ensuring flexible scalability for demanding workloads.

Robust Server-Management Solution

ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 incorporates the ASUS ASMB10-iKVM, a powerful server-management solution based on the ASPEED 2600 chipset and AMI MegaRAC SP-X. It enables out-of-band server management through WebGUI, IPMI, and Redfish API, streamlining server administration and ensuring seamless control.

Enhanced Security

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 integrates PFR FPGA as the platform Root-of-Trust solution, it ensures firmware resiliency, safeguarding your infrastructure from potential hackers. The server is also fully compliant with the 2018 NIST SP 800 193 specification and includes support for Trusted Platform Module 2.0 (TPM 2.0) to secure hardware through integrated cryptographic keys and firmware updates for vulnerabilities.

ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Intel Xeon E-2334 Tower Server

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Tower Server is powered by an Intel Xeon E-2334 Processor, clocked at 3.60GHz (up to 4.80GHz), with 4 cores and 8 threads. This server ensures seamless multitasking and fast processing. It comes with 16GB of RAM and supports up to 128GB, making it capable of handling demanding workloads and data-intensive applications. Server management is made simple and effective with the ASUS Control Center Enterprise and ASMB10-iKVM card. The Aspeed AST2510 graphics card has 64MB VRAM and an 80PLUS Single Power Supply with a 300W rating, which further improves both performance and reliability. The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 is a versatile and dependable server solution for businesses that is compatible with a number of operating systems, including Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, RedHat Enterprise Linux, SuSE Linux Enterprise Server, CentOS, and VMware.

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 embraces the cutting-edge PCIe 4.0 technology, delivering 16 GT/s bandwidth, double the speed of PCIe 3.0. This enables lower power consumption, better lane scalability, and backwards compatibility, ensuring flexible scalability for demanding workloads.

Robust Server-Management Solution

ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 incorporates the ASUS ASMB10-iKVM, a powerful server-management solution based on the ASPEED 2600 chipset and AMI MegaRAC SP-X. It enables out-of-band server management through WebGUI, IPMI, and Redfish API, streamlining server administration and ensuring seamless control.

Enhanced Security

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 integrates PFR FPGA as the platform Root-of-Trust solution, it ensures firmware resiliency, safeguarding your infrastructure from potential hackers. The server is also fully compliant with the 2018 NIST SP 800 193 specification and includes support for Trusted Platform Module 2.0 (TPM 2.0) to secure hardware through integrated cryptographic keys and firmware updates for vulnerabilities.

Dell PowerEdge R450 Xeon Silver 4310 Rack Server

The Dell PowerEdge R450 Rack Server is powered by two Intel Xeon Silver 4310 2.1GHz Up to 3.30GHz, 12C/24T, 10.4GT/s, 18M Cache, Turbo, HT (120W) DDR4-2666. The front door features tempered glass with a round lock, offering both visibility and physical security, while removable side panels allow easy access for maintenance and cable routing. The DATEUP 9U Server Rack comes equipped with two low-noise cooling fans to maintain optimal airflow and prevent overheating, ensuring stable performance for sensitive hardware. It also includes a 6-port universal socket PDU for efficient power distribution and integrated cable management features to reduce clutter and improve airflow. The rack rails support cage nut-style mounting, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of equipment and simplifying installation. Designed for both wall-mounted and floor-standing configurations, this versatile rack adapts to various deployment needs. Whether you're setting up a new network infrastructure or upgrading an existing system, the DATEUP 9U Server Rack offers a professional-grade, space-efficient, and reliable solution that combines security, functionality, and ease of use—making it a top choice for IT professionals and businesses looking to streamline their server and networking setups.
